evidence: Walked instruction.md and all six /instructions notes line by line against solution/app; found no asked-for screen, control or flow without an implementation. WORKSPACE (overview.md, ui.md last paragraph): src/app.tsx:146-174 renders title and filename fields, Run, Stop, New, Save, the editor host, the saved library, revision history, the preview and the console together; no sign-in; New starts with a small example (app.tsx:97-101). EDITOR (ui.md): src/custom-editor.js:23 is an own DOM surface (div role=textbox, no textarea/contenteditable/editor library; package.json lists only acorn, acorn-walk, @lezer/html, prettier, react). Numbered lines and one-based 'Ln 1, Col 1' readout (1109, 1125-1127); typing, Enter, Backspace, Delete, arrows, Home/End, Ctrl/Cmd+Home/End, Shift-extend (279-356, 775-812); remembered column (preferredCol, 795-800); grapheme-aware movement and deletion via Intl.Segmenter (884-922); caret kept in view on both axes (1145-1160); click, double-click word, triple-click logical line, drag with auto-scroll (358-447); copy/cut/paste events (248-267); replace-selection and one-step paste Undo (570-586); long line unwrapped and horizontally scrollable (style.css:14,16); Tab/Shift+Tab block indent including a single-line selection and excluding a line where the selection ends at column 0 (344-350, 843-866); Alt and Ctrl/Cmd+Click carets, same-line carets by document offset, multi-caret Backspace/Delete, untimed typing burst as one Undo (364-378, 592-610, 574-580, 680-724); Undo/Redo buttons and shortcuts with caret restored from the snapshot and disabled state when empty (190-242, 298-308, 1165-1166), history reset on New/open (72-80, app.tsx:59); no-op Format adds no Undo step (92); literal case-sensitive Find, wrapping Next/Previous, Replace current that skips just-inserted text, split/join Replace all as one Undo (978-1102); JS and HTML token colouring with distinct treatments (105-188, style.css:25-31); Format document through prettier babel/html, two-space, single Undo, error message leaving the draft (83-104); Escape-then-Tab exit shown on screen (271-277, 1174, app.tsx:173); worded feedback after Run/Save/Format (app.tsx:72,150; custom-editor.js:99); focus returned to the code after Format/Undo/Redo/replace/Save (65, 98, app.tsx:68,76); dirty marker computed against the saved baseline so Undo to the saved text clears it (app.tsx:43,145,152); 390 px rules (style.css:34-50,73). RUNTIME (behaviour.md): src/runtime.ts buildRun/PreviewRunner give a new sandboxed iframe per run (384-394), .html replaces the document (320-331), syntax errors reported with line and draft untouched (387-388), ordered console forwarding (158, 400), thrown-error and unhandled-rejection lines including HTML offsets (46-48, 113, 223-229, 357), last-good snapshot with control values and canvas pixels restored after throw/Stop/timeout (159-203, 8-31, 376-383, 405), 4.9 s in-frame deadline plus 5.1 s parent watchdog (139-141, 376), fresh budget on trusted interaction after settle (270-282, 402), Stop and superseding Run discard the old frame and token (380-386, 397). SECURITY (security.md): sandbox=allow-scripts on a cross-host runner URL (389-393), CSP connect-src 'none', no unsafe-eval/wasm-unsafe-eval, worker-src 'none' (7, 363), dynamic import refused from the AST so strings/comments stay harmless (50-52), clear refusal text (220-228). SAVING (behaviour.md, integration.md): server.js SQLite at DB_PATH or /app/app.db (8, 147-173), POST/PUT with revision check returning 409 and keeping the draft (69-91, 54-61; app.tsx:62-77,154), 2 s library poll that only replaces the list and shows a newer-revision notice without loading it (app.tsx:137-144,155), read-only history showing title, filename and source (app.tsx:160-162), restore as a new revision guarded by base revision and made repeat-safe by operationId (server.js:96-119), /api/health and static / (12, 131-132). The built bundle public/assets/index.js contains the distinctive strings of these source features (e.g. 'Already formatted.', 'script-src-attr', 'was saved in another tab', 'Retry same restore', 'wasm-eval'), so the served app is the reviewed source. RUN EVIDENCE: the scripted golden results listed in raw-evidence-index.json (hashes verified) report all 21 editor, 15 runtime, 7 polish and 9 persistence/restart checks true with no page errors; the index states these ran on the previous commit whose only difference is one paragraph in each judge prompt.md, so the solution bytes are the ones exercised. This is scripted evidence, not a configured-judge or portal result, and no Oracle score is claimed for these bytes. NOTES (not defects in this row): (1) The editor has no hidden input, so IME/dead-key composition and a phone soft keyboard cannot type into it; the brief asks only for normal typing, paste and usability at about 390 px width. (2) prettier is bundled without its CSS plugin (custom-editor.js:3-6,88), so the contents of a <style> block in an HTML draft are left as written by Format; the brief does not single out CSS. (3) HTML-mode colouring does not colour JavaScript inside <script>; the brief lists only HTML tag names, attribute names, quoted values and comments for HTML. (4) golden-390.png shows a blank preview pane although polish.cjs:128 asserted the preview body text 'narrow ok' immediately before the screenshot; this looks like a full-page capture artefact of the cross-origin frame, not a missing feature. (5) Unused extras (auto-run state, DELETE route, resizable dividers) are harmless surplus.
